prompts.prompt: Build a runnable workflow that loops over the tickers AAPL and MSFT, fetches recent headlines for each ticker, writes a short markdown note for each ticker, and then produces one final combined summary. Add retry around the web step if it can fail.
Create a runnable workflow that takes a CSV path as input, reads the CSV, loops over each row, extracts the symbol column, and writes one short note file per symbol.
Make a runnable workflow that takes an article title as input, turns it into a slug in code, and writes a text file to /tmp/{slug}.txt containing the original title.
Build a runnable workflow that loops over the numbers 1, 2, and 3, doubles each item inside the loop, and returns the doubled list.
multi_turn_follow_ups: Now add a final step after the loop that sums the doubled values without breaking the existing loop behavior.

prompts.prompt: Build a runnable workflow that searches the web for the latest earnings date for NVDA, retries the search once if it fails transiently, and writes a concise markdown summary file with the result.
Build a runnable workflow that loops over 1, 2, and 3, triples each item, and then produces a final sum from the loop results.
multi_turn_follow_ups: Repair the workflow if the final sum step is reading the current loop item instead of the collected loop results. Keep the external behavior the same.

prompts.prompt: Build a runnable workflow that takes a title, generates a slug in code, and writes the title to /tmp/{slug}.txt.
multi_turn_follow_ups: Repair the workflow if the write step is using a literal placeholder string instead of the generated slug value.

prompts.prompt: Build a runnable workflow that trims whitespace from a text input in a code step and then writes the cleaned text to /tmp/clean.txt.
multi_turn_follow_ups: Repair the workflow if the code step is relying on a bare top-level return instead of assigning the node output value.

prompts.prompt: Build a runnable workflow that takes a CSV path, reads the CSV, counts the rows, and writes a short markdown summary file.
multi_turn_follow_ups: Repair the workflow if it invented a made-up CSV tool or wrong port names. Use the real registered tool and keep it runnable.
